adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog.tsx` the error handler builds `const message = `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`;` and then calls `showToast(message || t("unable_to_add_guests"), "error")`. A template literal always produces a string (e.g. `"undefined: booking_not_found"`), which is truthy, so the `unable_to_add_guests` fallback will never be used. This makes the new locale key effectively dead and can surface unhelpful/untranslated output like `undefined: <key>` on unexpected errors.
